intro.heading: Collecting and preserving the heritage of the Melrose area.
intro.lede: Formed in 1987, the Society operates a museum and research center so that the artifacts and stories of our neighbors — maybe even your grandparents — are there for everyone to enjoy.
intro.body: As you visit, investigate the past through the exhibits in each room. See the displays that depict the life and times of our pioneers and citizens, and learn of the settlement of these communities through each era. The collection now numbers more than 2,000 indexed items.
